author: muse-b2
covers: Hand recipe (kind repro-steps) for SX-ORC-12, authored by muse-b2 as author of record (CB-0823 ORC subgroup) from the fixer's supplied content: /Users/dutch/.zuko/quality/SX-ORC-12.check.md (seat B3, branch sx/core-loop, commit bc142e051). Value-assertion provenance: INDEPENDENT for the mass value (analytic cube at declared density, computed by hand); SELF-REFERENCED for the claim-key vocabulary (declared in the solver — drift coverage only, never quoted externally as correctness). Behaviour: an assembler over the five landed solvers' outputs (system-architecture, mass-bom, bom-structure, integration-checks, research-gaps) that extracts claims and mints a receipt for every one — producing solver plus the value's path inside its outputs; the output carries an unreceipted list that must be empty. The assembler copies values and computes no new engineering numbers; its one owned computation is consistency — the mass total arrives by two independent roll-ups and must agree within 1e-9 kg, a disagreement named with BOTH values standing, never averaged. Absent sections are named and stamp the report PARTIAL; NOT_COMPUTED values ride as claims so gaps appear as gaps; a previous input yields the added/removed/changed version diff. The suite assembles from REAL upstream solver outputs (all five producers run in-suite — the assembled-chain exercise, not hand-shaped fixtures). The report is the human-readable surface the signed chain artifact (SX-CHAIN-RECEIPT) feeds. Reviewer: at activation, confirm the discriminator transcript below still fails against the pinned pre-fix instance and bind packet_id.
discriminator: Pre-fix transcript (from SX-ORC-12.check.md, replayed against f4f1f77ff): no orc.system-report in the registry; the stack's outputs exist only as separate envelopes with no assembled, receipted system view. Post-fix: registered at L1 with declarations and no engine dependency; suite 9/9 green locally, assembled from real upstream outputs. Reference case: full chain (robot architecture; 0.1 m cube at 1000 kg/m^3 through both roll-ups; closing power budget; one research gap) -> COMPLETE, claimCount >= 15, every claim receipted, mass.totalKg = 1 kg copied from orc.mass-bom, inconsistencies empty; BOM quantity doubled -> PARTIAL with one inconsistency naming both totals (1 kg vs 2 kg), neither averaged.
steps: Via MCP conkay_solve {solver_id: "orc.system-report", typed inputs from docs/conkay/solvers/orc.system-report.md's replay request} — expect envelope PASS with outputs.unreceipted empty, the mass.totalKg claim valued 1 with receipt solver "orc.mass-bom", completeness PARTIAL with the four absent sections named.
Adversarial: the doubled-BOM assembly — expect one inconsistency naming both totals.
title: orc.system-report: every claim carries its receipt, and the two mass roll-ups must agree or both values stand named
